subject: Chemistry
title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
summary: Atom bond isliye banate hain kyunki bond banne par energy kam hoti hai aur zyadatar atom stable (octet) configuration paa lete hain. Ionic bond = electron dena-lena; covalent bond = electron share karna.
Shape ka raaz VSEPR hai: central atom ke electron pairs ek doosre se door rehna chahte hain, aur lone pair, bond pair se zyada jagah leta hai (lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp).
Hybridisation shape ko orbitals ki bhasha mein samjhata hai (sp linear, sp² trigonal, sp³ tetrahedral, sp³d TBP, sp³d² octahedral).
Molecular orbital theory bond order aur magnetism batati hai — O₂ ka paramagnetism sirf MOT se samajh aata hai. Bond order zyada ⇒ bond chhota aur mazboot.

formulas.name: Formal charge
formulas.when: Best Lewis structure chunna (V = valence e⁻, L = lone e⁻, B = bonding e⁻).
formulas.mistake: Lowest formal charges wala structure zyada stable.

formulas.name: Bond order (MOT)
formulas.when: Bond length, strength, existence compare karna.

formulas.name: Hybridisation shortcut
formulas.when: Central atom ki hybridisation jaldi nikalna (V = valence e⁻, M = monovalent atoms, c = cation charge, a = anion charge).
formulas.mistake: H = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ⇒ sp, sp², sp³, sp³d, sp³d².

formulas.name: Dipole moment
formulas.mistake: Symmetric molecule (CO₂, BF₃, CH₄) mein bond dipoles cancel ⇒ μ = 0.

formulas.name: VSEPR shapes (ratta)
formulas.formula: AB₂ linear · AB₃ trigonal planar · AB₄ tetrahedral · AB₃E pyramidal · AB₂E₂ bent · AB₅ TBP · AB₄E see-saw · AB₃E₂ T-shape · AB₂E₃ linear · AB₆ octahedral · AB₅E square pyramidal · AB₄E₂ square planar

examples.title: O₂ family ka bond order
examples.problem: O₂⁺, O₂, O₂⁻, O₂²⁻ ko bond order aur bond length ke order mein lagao.
examples.solution: Bond order: O₂⁺ 2.5 > O₂ 2 > O₂⁻ 1.5 > O₂²⁻ 1. Bond length ulta: O₂⁺ sabse chhota, O₂²⁻ sabse lamba. O₂²⁻ diamagnetic hai, baaki teen paramagnetic.

examples.title: Hybridisation shortcut
examples.problem: I₃⁻ aur ClF₃ ki hybridisation aur shape?
examples.solution: I₃⁻: H = ½(7 + 2 + 1) = 5 ⇒ sp³d; 2 bond pair + 3 lone pair ⇒ linear. ClF₃: H = ½(7 + 3) = 5 ⇒ sp³d; 3 bp + 2 lp ⇒ T-shaped.

examples.title: Ozone ka formal charge
examples.problem: O₃ (O=O–O) ke har oxygen ka formal charge?
examples.solution: Central O: 6 − 2 − ½(6) = +1. Double-bonded O: 6 − 4 − ½(4) = 0. Single-bonded O: 6 − 6 − ½(2) = −1.

topics.title: Lone pair ka asar
topics.explain: CH₄ 109.5°, NH₃ ~107°, H₂O ~104.5° — har extra lone pair angle ko aur dabata hai.

topics.title: Fajans' rule
topics.explain: Chhota, zyada charge wala cation aur bada anion ⇒ zyada covalent character. Isliye LiCl, NaCl se zyada covalent hai.

topics.title: Hydrogen bonding
topics.explain: Intermolecular H-bond boiling point badhata hai (H₂O liquid hai). o-nitrophenol mein intramolecular H-bond ⇒ wo p-nitrophenol se zyada volatile hai.

topics.title: MOT filling order
topics.explain: B₂, C₂, N₂ tak π2p orbitals σ2p se pehle bhare jaate hain; O₂, F₂ mein σ2p pehle. B₂ paramagnetic, C₂ diamagnetic — PYQ mein aata hai.

topics.title: Resonance
topics.explain: Jab ek Lewis structure kaafi nahi (O₃, CO₃²⁻), asli molecule saare structures ka hybrid hota hai; saare bond lengths barabar ho jaate hain.

ratta: Shapes: BeCl₂ linear · BF₃ trigonal planar · CH₄ tetrahedral · NH₃ pyramidal · H₂O bent · PCl₅ TBP · SF₄ see-saw · ClF₃ T-shape · XeF₂ linear · SF₆ octahedral · BrF₅ square pyramidal · XeF₄ square planar.
μ = 0: CO₂, BF₃, CH₄, CCl₄, PCl₅, SF₆, XeF₄.
